rows.name: VLA
rows.model: stage 2 + flow-matching action transformer, 130.0M, everything trainable
quotes: | 3. VLA | stage 2 + flow-matching action transformer, 130.0M, everything trainable | 1500 `pick_target` demos | 1.0M samples, about 1.7 h at 165 samples/s | 0/100 (see above) |
Stage 1 ran out of memory at batch 128: the float32 logits for 128 x 256 tokens over a 49,280-word vocabulary are 6.5 GB per tensor.
Before the pixel-range fix (below) the stage-2 model scored 1/300 on exact ordering and 70/300 on the leftmost object.

A teacher-forced check on that model gave the same loss with the right and with a mismatched image when images were fed as PIL (1.93 vs 1.89), and 0.10 vs 1.18 when fed as the unscaled uint8 tensors it was trained on.
Language model final loss 4.15. VLM final loss 0.058; held-out captioning check 249/300 = 83% exact ordering and 279/300 = 93% leftmost object.

Both were trained before the position fix. The language model's sequences are 256 tokens long: no two of its positions were merged (the old table rounded their angles to 8 significant bits). The VLM's are 320 tokens long, and positions above 256 were merged in pairs.

vlmAfterFix.about: The VLM retrained after the position fix, same data and budget. The VLAs after the fix are built on it.
quotes: The VLM retrained after the fix (same data and budget): final loss 0.059, captioning check 267/300 = 89% exact ordering and 286/300 = 95% leftmost object.
The rotary position table was computed in bfloat16 under autocast, which keeps 8 significant bits
positions above 256 collapse onto even numbers, above 512 onto multiples of 4: 641 distinct positions out of 2048.

In the no-history policy (426 tokens before the actions: one for the noise level, 32 for the instruction, 392 patches, one for the joint state) the 15 action-step tokens, at positions 426-440, shared 8 positions; with history (about 820) 16 shared 4

the table is computed in float32 and then cast; test added. Effect: see 'The same run before and after the fix' (and the second pair of seeds in 'A second seed, with and without the fix') and the single cube with history
